The {{Term/Store|Ring|Rings|Series, HW}} is a class of [[Weapon]] used by [[Wizzro]] in {{HW}}.{{Name Ref|HW}} It is associated with [[Element|Darkness]].

==Variations==
The default Ring is the [[Blue Ring]], which is based on its namesake. The second form of the Ring is the [[Red Ring]], which is based on its [[Red Ring|namesake]]. The third form is the [[Magical Ring]].

===Special Attack===
{{Main|Special Attack}}
Wizzro cackles, sinking into the ground as slimy, cycloptic fish-like creatures leap from a pool of dark magic in the ground. The magic compresses into a ball and explodes, blowing enemies away, while the giggling Wizzro re-emerges from the ground. This attack deals damage in a wide area around Wizzro and carries no Element.{{verify}}
